summary: Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of an unsecured promissory note up to $1.5M to its sponsor to fund working capital pending a business combination. The non-interest-bearing note matures upon completion of an initial business combination, at which point the sponsor may convert principal into working capital warrants at $0.90 per warrant, matching terms of existing IPO private placement warrants. The filing reflects routine interim financing and does not announce a merger or special situation deal. No target, price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. The event is standard SPAC operational activity.
